claim: Combined PUM1/PUM2 depletion increases PMP22 labeled-RNA persistence in HEK293 cells.
context: GSE145237 / PMC7566576, HEK293, 48h dual PUM1/2 RNAi versus nontargeting control; 30min BrU pulse, 0h and 6h chase; four biological culture replicates per condition/time.
baseline_model: The K562 PUM2 association may be nonproductive or context-specific. Its uncertain abundance increase can also be indirect/nascent-output driven. No persistence increase in an independent context is required by binding alone.
prior_exposure: ENCORE candidate estimates and paper-wide GSE145237 findings/methods were inspected. No GSE145237 PMP22 measurement row has been retrieved or inspected in this session. Model prior knowledge cannot be excluded. This lock precedes target-table inspection, not a blinded experiment. TCam-2 pilot and HCT116 supplement inspection occurred earlier and any tests on them will remain retrospective, not part of this prospective-in-session claim.
prediction: PMP22 has a positive siPUM-by-6h interaction for relative labeled-RNA abundance, with a finite nonzero-information coefficient and gene-wise adjusted p<=0.05. Nascent-response coefficient is reported separately, without claiming equivalence from nonsignificance.
analysis_plan: Inspect the native complete processed model-coefficient table and retain its entire feature/status background. Identify PMP22 by explicit symbol or source-supported ENSG00000109099 mapping. Preserve source coefficients, errors, filtering/NA flags, and contrast direction. Prefer reported log2 coefficients and their uncertainty; never relabel the standardized interaction Wald statistic as a log2 effect. Report source all-gene FDR and nominal Wald CI when SE exists. If sample-level processed counts are supplied, inspect full design and use descriptive within-source validation only; no raw processing or invented counts. Keep HEK293 separate from K562 and from Schwann contexts.
success_rule: Eligible PMP22 interaction estimate is positive and source gene-wise adjusted p<=0.05; report exact effect scale and uncertainty. This supports a combined PUM perturbation association in HEK293, not PUM2-specific causation or Schwann transfer.
failure_rule: A finite eligible interaction that does not meet the success rule fails this prediction. A significant negative interaction contradicts its direction. Missing/filtered/out-of-universe PMP22 or undefined effect uncertainty makes the test untestable, not zero. Nonsignificance is not equivalence. Preserve the original rule; do not rescue it with an abundance-only endpoint or a different gene.
confounder_checks: Joint PUM1/2 depletion cannot identify PUM2-specific action
Cell line/siRNA and assay differences preclude direct Schwann transfer
Global relative normalization and ongoing processing can affect persistence estimands
0h nascent abundance and 6h persistence must remain separate
Verify PUM1/PUM2 perturbation controls and source coverage/status; no biological donor inference
selection_and_multiplicity: One PMP22 persistence hypothesis selected from the completed broad screen on binding grounds, not a new five-binder FDR denominator. Retain source genome-wide FDR; auxiliary PUM1/PUM2 and paper controls are assay checks, not additional discovery claims. Other independent abundance comparisons are retrospective and separately corrected/described.
